visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with large brown curly hair, glasses, and a pink anime-character printed shirt dances energetically in a bright white-walled hallway. He shakes his head vigorously and makes dramatic facial expressions while holding a spoon. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a modern kitchen with light wood cabinetry. The man places a black container on the counter and pours powder into a purple electric shaker bottle. He then fills the bottle with water from a dispenser, looking intensely at the camera with exaggerated focus. (3) He dances through various parts of the apartment, including a hallway and a living room area, while holding the purple shaker. He strikes several poses, showing off the bottle to the camera with a confident smile and theatrical hand gestures. (4) In the kitchen, he stands by the sink, rinsing the shaker or cleaning up. He looks directly at the camera with a sly expression before reaching up to adjust his wig, bringing the sequence to a close.
